attempts.text:
**The window opens on a spine.** Columns 0 to 3, `hemB` to `tauB`, are carried by 91 to 100% of chromosomes, all persistent, in a region of plasticity in 0.2 to 5% of calls. The model names 94 to 98% of them, fewest at column 1, `tauD`, 94%.

**Then the `mhp` genes**, columns 13 to 20, [[hydroxyphenylpropionate catabolism]], carried by 83 to 86%. Through columns 41 to 45 a branch of 5 families runs in 21 to 22%, [[ABC transport]].

**The model names more genes on the spine columns than on the fork and variable ones**, 95 against 87%, and hesitates less there, 0.29 against 0.69 bits. It hesitates most at column 6, `yaiP`, a fork column, 1.55 bits.

**The window ends on fork and variable columns.** Columns 56 to 79 are carried by 13 to 88%, 23 shell and 1 persistent. The last column is `paoB`, in 35% of chromosomes.

**Across the window it names 89% of genes**, 0.58 bits on average, perplexity 1.9 families. Inside a region of plasticity it hesitates more than outside, 0.69 against 0.26 bits, and names fewer genes, 87% against 95%.

label: hemB
facts:
[W] WINDOW: the hemB window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor hemB, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 3,340 to 3,419 from dnaA. Read in 537 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying hemB once); 42,960 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
[T] TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
[G] WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 89% of genes, 0.58 bits on average (perplexity 1.9 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 11,484 calls, named 97%, 0.22 bits; shell 30,893 calls, named 88%, 0.65 bits; cloud 583 calls, named 6%, 4.00 bits. Outside an RGP 10,993 calls, named 95%, 0.26 bits; inside an RGP 31,967 calls, named 87%, 0.69 bits. Columns: 22 spine, 17 fork, 41 variable.
[C] COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (0.69 against 0.26 bits) and names fewer genes (87% against 95%); 31,967 of the 42,960 calls are inside an RGP.
[H] HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 6 (yaiP, a fork column) 1.55 bits, RGP 86%; column 5 ("protein YkiC", a fork column) 1.40 bits, RGP 86%; column 7 ("acetyltransferase", a variable column) 1.32 bits, RGP 86%. The 64 columns (columns 4-8, 13-28 and 37-79) where most calls are in an RGP: named 87%, 0.67 bits on average; the other 16 columns: named 96%, 0.23 bits.
[M] BY KIND OF COLUMN (computed, over the columns with calls): the 22 spine columns: named 95%, 0.29 bits on average; the 58 fork and variable columns: named 87%, 0.69 bits. The model names more genes on the spine columns than on the fork and variable ones, and hesitates less there. Its most hesitant column, 6, is a fork column.
[P] PLASTICITY (the stretches below, by their mean over columns): the stretch most in regions of plasticity: columns 53-55 (spine), RGP 94%; the least: columns 0-3 (spine), RGP 0.2-5%.
[L] STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
[S1] 1. columns 0-3 (4 columns) spine: share 91-100%, all P, RGP 0.2-5%. Genes: hemB, tauD, tauC "taurine ABC transporter permease Ta…", tauB. named 94-98% (mean 96%), fewest named at column 1 (tauD), named 94%; most hesitant at column 0 (hemB), 0.36 bits.
[S2] 2. columns 4-8 (5 columns) fork and variable columns: share 60-90%, all S, RGP 77-86%. named 69-96% (mean 89%), fewest named at column 5, named 69%; most hesitant at column 6, 1.55 bits.

[S3] 3. columns 9-12 (4 columns) spine: share 94-95%, all P, RGP 6-19%. Genes: frmR, frmA "S-(hydroxymethyl)glutathione dehydr…", fghA, yaiL "DUF2058 domain-containing protein". named 97-98% (mean 97%), fewest named at column 9 (frmR), named 97%; no column of this stretch hesitates more than 0.19 bits (column 12 (yaiL)).
[S4] 4. columns 13-20 (8 columns) variable: share 83-86%, all S, RGP 70-87%. named 95-99% (mean 98%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 13, named 95%, 0.26 bits.

[S5] 5. columns 21-23 (3 columns) spine: share 91-94%, 2 P, 1 S, RGP 86-87%. Genes: lacI, lacZ, lacY "lactose permease". named 89-97% (mean 94%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 23 (lacY), named 89%, 0.76 bits.
